Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

ogis 2026.11.18.10

  • rebelrebel is renamed ogis, its prefix rr_ now og_: every function (og_map(), og_point(), og_serve(), …) and class (og_map, og_layer, og_section), and in the page what a script of its own sees: the object it is given (og: og.on(), og.state(), og.fetch(), …), the features’ key (og_row) and the classes its styles may name (.og-panel). A map’s own route header is X-OG-Notes. Names the engine kept from ramb (rb) are og too. Nothing else changed: a call made with the rr_ names is the same call with og_. The entries below keep the names of their day.

Developed by Einar Hjörleifsson.
